transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been feeling like certain people in the arts and finance circles around Cincinnati are tracking who I meet with. Little things—event invitations, panel topics, even where people sit near me—feel like signals. I know it could be coincidence, but I can’t really shake the feeling.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No, I haven’t heard voices or sounds that other people couldn’t hear.
About how long have you been having these feelings that people are tracking you?
About two months now. That’s when I started feeling like people were tracking my client meetings and sending signals.
During these past two months, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?
I’m not sure I’d call it depression. I’ve been more worried and preoccupied, but I haven’t really noticed feeling persistently sad or down.
Over the past couple of months, have you had times where you felt unusually high, energetic, or wired?
I haven’t really noticed times like that. I’ve mostly just felt worried and distracted, not unusually energetic or wired.
Have you ever felt like thoughts that aren't your own were being placed directly into your mind?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had a lot on my mind, but it still feels like my own thoughts.
Have you ever felt like an outside force or power was controlling your body or actions against your will?
No, I haven’t felt like anything outside of me was controlling what I did or how my body moved.
Before these past two months, have you generally been a very suspicious person or found it hard to trust others throughout your adult life?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I’ve generally been a very suspicious person throughout my adult life.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts were being broadcast or transmitted so that other people could hear or know them?
No, I haven’t noticed my thoughts being broadcast or other people somehow hearing them.
Have you been using any alcohol, recreational drugs, or new medications over the past couple of months?
I’m not sure what would count as new, but I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
